simple.meaning: עָתִיד (ʻâthîyd) is a Hebrew word meaning “prepared ; by implication, skilful ; feminine plural the future ; also treasure.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: עָתִיד (H6264) appears 7 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Deuteronomy 32:35, with occurrences in Deuteronomy, Esther, Job, Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עָתִיד (H6264) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in עָתִיד (H6264) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: עָתִיד (ʻâthîyd) / H6264 is traced through Deuteronomy 32:35, Esther 3:14, Esther 8:13, Job 3:8 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: prepared ; by implication, skilful ; feminine plural the future ; also treasure
definitions.usage: things that shall come, ready, treasures.

occurrences.englishText: A copy of the letter, that the decree should be given out in every province, was published to all the peoples, that they should be ready against that day.
A copy of the letter, that the decree should be given out in every province, was published to all the peoples, that the Jews should be ready for that day to avenge themselves on their enemies.
Let them curse it who curse the day,
Distress and anguish make him afraid.

For he has said, “By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom; for I have understanding. I have removed the boundaries of the peoples, and have robbed their treasures. Like a valiant man I have brought down their rulers.
